svg.title: Exact homogeneous fold shifts and two-form cancellation

cc:Work.dc:title: Exact homogeneous fold shifts and two-form cancellation
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact model V=2t, W=-2t^3/3 with fixed spectators and positive frequency; not flow trajectories.
